text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 Pager — embeddings-service (eu-west-1) 503 spike. Triage doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3101234567 — logs + Grafana links in thread.

Emily Chen: I'm on the last 10m of my shift. seeing the spike on my dashboard. I'll start bridge handoff but need a driver assigned immediately.

Raj Patel: oncall here, I'm available to take driver if you need to head out. can you confirm user impact?

Emily Chen: Customer impact looks like increased 503 for batch embedding jobs; intermittent failures for ~32 customers. latency also up. Rough ETA for impact window unknown.

Samir Gupta: quick check — kv-cache eviction rate shot up on the podset. looks related to a recent config roll but not 100% yet. linking config diff: https://stash.redwood/config/changes/8272

Nora Diaz: I can take comms (status updates / paging). Emily, please hand off anything still running. Raj, want you to drive infra diagnostics (logs + rollback plan).

Emily Chen: copying runbook excerpt for quick steps:```
Runbook: embeddings-503-spike
1) Verify region metric > svc.threshold
2) Check recent deploys: `git log --since=1h`
3) If config change: revert with `cicd revert <change-id>`
4) Enable additional replicas in eu-west-1: `kubectl scale deployment/embeddings --replicas=10 -n prod-euw`
5) Collect KV cache stats: `/tools/kv-stats --region euw`
6) Post interim status every 10m
```

Raj Patel: starting diagnostics now. first: `kubectl get pods -n prod-euw -o wide | grep embeddings` then tail controller logs. If config 8272 is culprit, recommend revert to previous commit and scale down new pods after revert.

Nora Diaz: I posted initial update to #status-pages and tagged support@customers (short note). Will send a 15m update once we confirm root cause.

Lin Moore: I'm nearby if you need extra hands for rollback or CI toggles. Keeping an eye on synthetic tests.

Samir Gupta: Confirmed config 8272 touched the tokenization worker count; can reproduce 503 locally with increased worker concurrency + cache pressure. Suggest immediate rollback of 8272.

Raj Patel: rolling back change 8272 now — firing CICD rollback job: `cicd rollback 8272` (started). ETA ~4m for traffic stabilization.

IncidentBot: CICD job 992> rollback started by raj. Job link: https://cicd.internal/jobs/992 (watching).

Nora Diaz: sending 15m interim to customers: "We're seeing elevated 503s for embeddings in eu-west-1. Team is investigating; rollback in progress. We'll update in 15 minutes or sooner." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Emily Chen: ok handing bridge to Raj as driver and Nora as comms. Raj/Nora — please confirm ownership so I can sign off and leave.

Raj Patel: I am driving. will own triage, rollback, and verification until stable.

Nora Diaz: Confirmed for comms. I'll own status updates and customer pings until Emily returns or handoff completes.

Emily Chen: thanks — I'm leaving now. @Samir and @Lin remain secondary if you need escalation. quick note for next shift: monitor KV cache hit-ratio for 30m post-rollback.

Raj Patel: rollback succeeded, pods back to previous image. prelim metrics show 503 rate dropping to baseline. leaving additional checks running — will confirm in 10m.

Nora Diaz: posted update: "Rollback complete; errors decreasing; monitoring for flare-ups. Next update in 10m." cc: @oncall-rotation

Samir Gupta: follow-up action: open ticket to add canary gating for tokenization worker config. filing now.

Lin Moore: noted gap: no auto-rollback for this config change type. flagged for eng-infra backlog.

IncidentBot: Incident status -> mitigated. Please run postmortem checklist when stable.

Raj Patel: leaving bridge to overnight oncall — @Ayla (next shift) please pick up postmortem and verification steps. tagging oncall rotation.

Nora Diaz: handoff complete from Emily -> Raj (driver) + Nora (comms) -> oncall rotation for PM/next shift. Good handoff. :white_check_mark:
